messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often will the Effer hydraulic truck-mounted crane at position 7 have to be verified on 1 June 2029?

response.text: Dato che l'azienda opera in aree minerarie (settore estrattivo), con quale frequenza la gru idraulica montata su autocarro Effer in posizione 7 dovrà essere verificata il 1 giugno 2029?
